answer: Resist sybils with mandatory jury service: every identity is drafted each epoch to grade peers' work, staking tokens on each verdict. A marble-hard rule checks verdicts against consensus: lazy or copied grades forfeit the stake, and a comet of correlated bad verdicts exposes whole clusters. An honest agent grades once per epoch, a beacon of real judgment. Ten thousand fakes need ten thousand genuine graders, each risking stake per verdict, while an honest agent serves one shift cheaply.
